hc.hi: Hi! What do you want to know? Tap a question below.

what.a: Own Two Feet is a student venture planning live, in-person workshops where boys and young men practice everyday skills: basic tools, online safety, money, simple cooking, communication and knowing when to ask for help.

status.a: Not yet. Own Two Feet is a student venture that’s still in development, so no workshops are running or booking. Join the interest list and we’ll email you when we launch.

who.a: Boys and young men in grades 3 to 8. Activities are matched to their age, and topics for older students come later.

modules.a: Eight topics: home and tools, tech and online safety, personal care, simple cooking, money, communication, knowing when to ask for help, and car basics later on. Schools pick the ones they want.

session.a: 50 or 90 minutes: start with a real-life situation, watch a mentor do it, practice it yourself, then wrap up with when to ask for help and a card to take home.

host.q: Can my school get a workshop?
host.a: Not yet, since we’re not booking. Join the interest list and pick “An in-person workshop.” Once we launch, you’d provide a room, up to 30 students and an adult who knows them. We’d bring everything else.

cost.a: We plan to charge $200 for a 50-minute workshop and $300 for a 90-minute one, per session, for up to 30 students. We bring the supplies. Or run our activities yourself with a monthly online plan: $9.99 a month for a teacher or volunteer who shows proof, or $19.99 a month for a team of three. These are planned prices, and nothing is booking yet.

video.q: Couldn’t students just watch a video?
video.a: Videos can show the steps. In a workshop, a real person explains why, fixes mistakes right away, and talks about when to stop.

safe.q: How do you keep it safe?
safe.a: Everything is supervised and right for their age. No electrical, gas or dangerous repairs, and every topic covers when to stop and get an adult or a pro.

parents.q: I’m a parent. How can I help?
parents.a: Join the interest list as a parent or guardian to hear about family workshop days, or suggest skills you’d like covered.

try.a: Yes! There are five you can try right now: Tool Time, Saturday on $25, Scam or Safe?, Make the Call and Laundry Sort-Out.

person.q: Can I talk to a person?
person.a: This chat can only answer the questions listed here. To reach our team, join the interest list and put your question in the notes box. We’ll get back to you.
